question: Does an independent 25% sleeve for the already frozen six-day BTC case stream preserve the September 16 case entry while adding EMA-prefiltered BTC ordinary admissions?
hypothesis_status: post-hoc assumption after inspecting the EMA-prefiltered ordinary stream and the September 16 missed case entry
single_variable: Partition the original BTC 50% allocation into two independent 25% sleeves: the 177-entry EMA-prefiltered ordinary stream and the original BTC case stream. Keep 50% for the original ALT 24h stream. No leverage, transfers, or rebalancing.

semantics.ordinary_source: EMA20-prefiltered ordinary source, frozen 177 VectorBT 144h time-exit fills; do not rerun entry selection or fills
semantics.case_source: Preserve all 53 original 5% BTC case admissions. They were already six-day-reserved separately in each original epoch before merging against ordinary BTC funding; do not reserve or suppress them again.
semantics.case_exit: Frozen native policy_id=4 half take-profit with remaining position held to six days; use cached fills only
semantics.alt_source: Original freq36_ALT basket and 24h cadence, cached 6h VectorBT exits
semantics.costs: 5bp taker per side for ordinary and ALT; case policy_id=4 native fee fills; 2026 funding applied only with complete locally cached settlement coverage
semantics.history: Full-history summary uses fee-only event returns; 2026 summary uses funding-adjusted event returns and synchronized 5m marks

comparison: Also include the frozen original 50/50 below-plus-case BTC and ALT portfolio for context. All comparisons are retrospective; 24h-to-partitioned allocation is a post-hoc hypothesis.
